summary: Structured outputs. Constrains the final text block to valid JSON matching your schema.
combines: Supported on: claude-opus-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, claude-opus-4-5-20251101, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. On Amazon Bedrock: Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 4.5, Opus 4.5, Haiku 4.5.

Schema rules: `additionalProperties: false` required on every object, no external `$ref`, no recursive or circular schemas. Supported: object, array, string, integer, number, boolean, null, `enum` (scalars only), `const`, `anyOf`, `allOf`, internal `$ref`/`$defs`/`definitions`, `default`, `required`, string formats (date-time, time, date, duration, email, hostname, uri, ipv4, ipv6, uuid), and array `minItems` of only 0 or 1. Not supported: `minimum`, `maximum`, `multipleOf`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, other array constraints, and unsupported regex features in `pattern`.
Composes with strict tool use (`"strict": true`): the schema shapes the final answer while strict tools validate tool arguments.
Applies only to the final response, not to thinking content.
Grammars are compiled on first use and cached for 24 hours. Changing the schema or the set of tools invalidates the compiled grammar; changing only tool `name`/`description` does not.
Adds an injected system prompt, so input token counts rise slightly, and changing the format invalidates the prompt cache.

The old top-level `output_format` parameter and the `structured-outputs-2025-11-13` beta header are deprecated. Python SDK v1.0+ rejects `output_format` on `beta.messages.create()` and `count_tokens()`.
